emission-factors._about: Emission factors used by the carbon calculator. Each value is the sum of the listed DESNZ 2026 rows (direct + well-to-tank where published).

diesel.label: Generator diesel
diesel.method: Diesel (100% mineral diesel) combustion + WTT. Mineral diesel rather than the UK forecourt blend, because generator fuel outside the UK is not the UK blend; this is the higher of the two.

components.path: Fuels > Liquid fuels > Diesel (100% mineral diesel)
WTT- fuels > Liquid fuels > Diesel (100% mineral diesel)

hvo.label: Generator HVO
hvo.method: Biodiesel HVO + WTT. DESNZ reports biogenic CO2 separately as outside of scopes.

components.path: Bioenergy > Biofuel > Biodiesel HVO
WTT- bioenergy > WTT- biofuel > Biodiesel HVO

truck.label: Road freight
truck.method: HGV (non-refrigerated, all diesel), average of all HGVs, average laden, + WTT.

components.path: Freighting goods > HGV (non-refrigerated, all diesel) > Average non-refrigerated HGVs > Average laden
WTT- delivery vehs & freight > WTT- HGV (non-refrigerated, all diesel) > Average non-refrigerated HGVs > Average laden

air.label: Air freight
air.method: Freight flights, international to/from non-UK, with radiative forcing (RF), + WTT.

components.path: Freighting goods > Freight flights > International, to/from non-UK > With RF
WTT- delivery vehs & freight > WTT- freight flights > International, to/from non-UK > With RF
Freighting goods > Cargo ship > Container ship > Average
WTT- delivery vehs & freight > WTT- cargo ship > Container ship > Average
Freighting goods > Rail > Freight train
WTT- delivery vehs & freight > WTT- rail > Freight train

flight.label: Flights
flight.method: Flights international to/from non-UK, average passenger, with RF, + WTT. DESNZ includes an uplift for indirect routing.

components.path: Business travel- air > Flights > International, to/from non-UK > Average passenger > With RF
WTT- business travel- air > WTT- flights > International, to/from non-UK > Average passenger > With RF

train.label: Train
train.method: UK national rail + WTT. UK-specific: use a national operator factor where you have one.

components.path: Business travel- land > Rail > National rail
WTT- pass vehs & travel- land > WTT- rail > National rail

road.label: Car
road.method: Average car, unknown fuel, + WTT. Per vehicle-km: the app counts each road traveller as one vehicle unless you enter shared trips, which can only overstate.

components.path: Business travel- land > Cars (by size) > Average car > Unknown
WTT- pass vehs & travel- land > WTT- cars (by size) > Average car > Unknown
Business travel- land > Bus > Coach
WTT- pass vehs & travel- land > WTT- bus > Coach
Business travel- land > Bus > Average local bus
WTT- pass vehs & travel- land > WTT- bus > Average local bus
Waste disposal > Refuse > Commercial and industrial waste > Landfill

recycled.label: Recycled waste
recycled.method: Commercial and industrial waste, closed-loop recycling.

components.path: Waste disposal > Refuse > Commercial and industrial waste > Closed-loop

compost.label: Composted waste
compost.method: Organic: mixed food and garden waste, composting.

components.path: Waste disposal > Refuse > Organic: mixed food and garden waste > Composting
Waste disposal > Refuse > Commercial and industrial waste > Combustion

hotel.label: Hotel stay
hotel.method: DESNZ hotel stay factor for the country of the event. No fallback: a country not in the list needs a supplier figure.

notCovered.meals: DESNZ publishes no per-meal factor. Catering is estimated from catering spend with the spend-based multiplier, or from a per-meal figure supplied by the caterer.
notCovered.generatorOutput: DESNZ publishes fuel factors, not generator efficiency. The grid-versus-generator comparison needs the generator output in kWh from the hire company's sizing or logs.

grid-intensity._about: Lifecycle carbon intensity of electricity generation, latest year available per country. Lifecycle figures include upstream emissions, so they are higher than generation-only factors such as DESNZ UK electricity.
grid-intensity.method: carbon_intensity_elec (g CO2e/kWh) divided by 1000. Use a supplier-specific factor instead when the venue has a renewable contract with certificates.

spend-multipliers._about: Spend-based (environmentally extended input-output) multipliers for when no activity data exists. GHG Protocol Scope 3 guidance treats spend-based results as the lowest-quality method; replace them with activity or supplier data where you can.
spend-multipliers.unit: kg CO2e per GBP spent (2023 prices, excluding VAT)
spend-multipliers.method: Cost in the plan currency -> USD -> GBP at 2023 average exchange rates (currency.json), times the multiplier for the mapped SIC group. Costs are not deflated to 2023 prices: no published UK price index for the event year is in the reference set, and leaving prices undeflated can only overstate emissions. The multipliers describe UK supply chains.

Performance.reason: Performers are bought as creative, arts and entertainment services.

Stage & set.reason: Temporary stages and sets are built and erected on site as specialised construction works.

Projection.reason: Projectors and media servers are normally hired: rental and leasing services.

Pitch art.reason: Pitch art is large printed or sewn fabric: textiles.

Music.reason: Musicians, composers and producers: creative, arts and entertainment services.

Cast & community.reason: Cast costs (choreography, rehearsal, stipends) are creative, arts and entertainment services.

Crowd participation.reason: Card mosaics and printed items are printing services; for electronic wristbands choose 26.

Special effects.reason: Pyrotechnics and effects consumables are other chemical products (SIC 20.51 explosives sits in this group).

Lighting.reason: Lighting fixtures are normally hired: rental and leasing services.

Broadcast.reason: Broadcast specials are motion picture, video and TV programme production services.

Sound.reason: Audio systems are normally hired: rental and leasing services.

Other.reason: Default for show elements: creative, arts and entertainment services.

Artist fees & travel.reason: Artist fees. Enter travel in the carbon calculator, not here, or it is counted twice.

Rehearsals.reason: Rehearsal fields, marquees and equipment are hired.

Venue & site.reason: Venue hire: sports services and amusement and recreation services.

Crew & labour.reason: Freelance crew through agencies: employment services.

Logistics & freight.reason: Land transport services. Use the activity calculator instead when you have tonne-km.

Accommodation.reason: Accommodation services. Use hotel nights in the calculator instead when you have them.

Sustainability.reason: Mitigation payments are not a purchase of goods or services that emit; no multiplier.

Other.reason: Default: creative, arts and entertainment services.

currency._about: Average 2023 exchange rates, quoted as units of currency per US dollar. Used only to bring costs into the price basis of the spend-based multipliers (2023 GBP).
currency.notCovered: Currencies missing here (for example AED, SAR, QAR) have no published rate in this dataset, so spend-based CO2e is not calculated for them.

events._about: Published whole-event greenhouse gas footprints. Whole-event figures include venues, operations and travel; none of these isolate a ceremony. Use them as context and sanity checks, never as a ceremony estimate. status: measured = organiser's post-event figure; estimate = third-party or partial; projected = pre-event forecast. verification: 'excerpt' = the figure appeared in a search excerpt attributed to the cited page; 'uncertain' = the figure came from a search summary and the exact page could not be confirmed. No page was opened directly from the build environment (its network blocks these hosts), so check the cited page before client use.

closeout-benchmarks._about: Benchmarks built only from actuals in reference/closeouts/ (invoices, delivery dates, metered data). No scaling or extrapolation: the app shows the median with its range and sample size, and cites the files.
